description.value: Crystal Hut is an on-mountain dining destination operated by Whistler Blackcomb, situated on Blackcomb Mountain and reachable via gondola or the Whistler Mountain Bike Park lift system. It appears in Whistler Blackcomb's official dining listings alongside other resort restaurants, indicating it is a fully staffed, sit-down-style facility rather than a kiosk. For a cyclist descending from the bike park, it represents a mid-mountain refuelling stop with full resort infrastructure behind it.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Crystal Hut exists as a named dining option in Whistler Blackcomb's resort dining section, so the business is real and operating. However, the fetched page content is almost entirely navigation markup with no specific details about the Crystal Hut restaurant itself — no address, phone, menu, or amenity descriptions are present. The OSM record similarly carries no contact or amenity tags, so nearly all criteria fields must be null. Notably, the coordinates place this facility on Blackcomb Mountain, suggesting access likely requires a gondola or bike-park lift ticket rather than being freely walk/ride-up accessible.
concerns: On-mountain facility: coordinates place Crystal Hut on Blackcomb Mountain, meaning access for cyclists likely requires purchasing a gondola or bike-park lift ticket — it is not freely walk/ride-up accessible from the valley.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Crystal Hut is a real, operating restaurant within the Whistler Blackcomb resort, accessible to cyclists using the Whistler Mountain Bike Park lift system. It is a legitimate stop for mountain bikers and warrants inclusion despite requiring paid lift access.
enrichment_extras.notes: Crystal Hut is well-known locally as a waffle house on Blackcomb Mountain. Enrichment would benefit from a direct visit or a more content-rich web source (e.g. a dedicated Crystal Hut menu/info page if one exists).
